story.iWant: provide system monitoring and log management functionality
story.soThat: I can help users understand system status and facilitate problem diagnosis
story.tasks:
Task 1: Real-time System Monitoring Dashboard (AC: 1) - Subtask 1.1: Create SystemMonitor class for comprehensive system metrics collection - Subtask 1.2: Implement real-time service status monitoring with health checks - Subtask 1.3: Build performance metrics collection (CPU, memory, disk usage) - Subtask 1.4: Create monitoring dashboard using rich library with live updates - Subtask 1.5: Implement configurable monitoring intervals and thresholds
Task 2: Structured Logging System (AC: 2) - Subtask 2.1: Extend existing logger with structured log format and categorization - Subtask 2.2: Implement log level management (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL) - Subtask 2.3: Create component-based log categorization and tagging - Subtask 2.4: Build centralized log collection and aggregation system - Subtask 2.5: Implement log formatting standards across all launcher components
Task 3: Log Viewing and Analysis Tools (AC: 3) - Subtask 3.1: Create LogAnalyzer class with advanced search and filtering - Subtask 3.2: Implement keyword and pattern-based log search functionality - Subtask 3.3: Build interactive log viewer with pagination and real-time updates - Subtask 3.4: Create log analysis tools with trend identification and statistics - Subtask 3.5: Implement log highlighting and error correlation features
Task 4: Log Rotation and Cleanup Mechanisms (AC: 4) - Subtask 4.1: Implement automatic log rotation based on size and time - Subtask 4.2: Create log compression and archiving system - Subtask 4.3: Build configurable cleanup policies with retention periods - Subtask 4.4: Implement log storage quota management and alerts - Subtask 4.5: Create emergency cleanup procedures for disk space issues
Task 5: Log Export Functionality (AC: 5) - Subtask 5.1: Create LogExporter class with multiple export formats (JSON, CSV, TXT) - Subtask 5.2: Implement date range and filter-based export functionality - Subtask 5.3: Build privacy filtering system to remove sensitive information - Subtask 5.4: Create export packaging with ZIP compression and metadata - Subtask 5.5: Implement export validation and integrity checking

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Implement real-time system monitoring, displaying service status and performance metrics 2. Create structured logging system with support for log levels and categorization 3. Provide log viewing and analysis tools with keyword search capability 4. Implement log rotation and cleanup mechanisms to control log file sizes 5. Support log export functionality for technical support and problem reporting

doc.title: Epic 3: 错误处理与用户支持
doc.section: Story 3.4: 系统监控与日志管理
doc.snippet: 作为一键启动脚本，我需要提供系统监控和日志管理功能，以便帮助用户了解系统状态并便于问题诊断。验收标准包括实时系统监控、结构化日志系统、日志查看和分析工具、日志轮转和清理机制、日志导出功能。

doc.title: 一键启动脚本 Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: Python 3.11.14+ (LTS) 作为核心引擎，psutil 7.1.3+ 用于系统监控，rich 13.9.4+ 用于CLI界面，logging 内置用于日志系统。

doc.title: Story 5.3: User Support and Guidance System
doc.snippet: SupportOrchestrator类提供综合系统协调 - 用于监控系统协调和数据收集工作流。EnhancedKnowledgeBase类提供高级搜索和索引 - 扩展用于日志搜索和分析功能。

codeFile.reason: 现有的性能监控器提供了跨层性能监控、延迟测量和趋势分析功能，支持各种系统指标收集
支持编排器提供综合系统协调，可用于监控系统协调和数据收集工作流
增强知识库提供高级搜索和索引功能，可扩展用于日志搜索和分析
现有的日志工具提供统一的日志配置和管理功能，支持结构化日志
进度跟踪器提供实时进度跟踪、日志记录和用户反馈功能

dependency.name: psutil
dependency.usage: System monitoring and resource metrics collection

dependency.name: rich
dependency.usage: CLI interface for monitoring dashboard and log viewer

constraints.constraint: 利用ServiceManager模式进行综合系统监控，扩展到所有服务
扩展现有的logger.py结构化日志模式，用于综合日志管理和分析
所有监控功能必须提供实时更新，不影响系统性能（< 2%系统资源使用）
所有组件使用一致的日志格式进行统一分析
实现日志轮转和压缩以控制磁盘使用
确保日志导出功能过滤敏感信息
监控信息应便于非技术用户理解
设计为处理大量日志数据和扩展监控周期

interface.name: SystemMonitor
interface.signature: class SystemMonitor: __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any]), start_monitoring(self), get_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any], stop_monitoring(self)

interface.name: LogManager
interface.signature: class LogManager: __init__(self, log_config: Dict[str, Any]), setup_structured_logging(self), collect_logs(self, filters: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[LogEntry], rotate_logs(self), export_logs(self, format: str, filters: Dict[str, Any]) -> bytes

interface.name: LogAnalyzer
interface.signature: class LogAnalyzer: search_logs(self, query: str, filters: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[LogEntry], analyze_patterns(self, logs: List[LogEntry]) -> AnalysisResult, get_statistics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]

interface.name: LogExporter
interface.signature: class LogExporter: export_to_json(self, logs: List[LogEntry]) -> str, export_to_csv(self, logs: List[LogEntry]) -> str, export_to_txt(self, logs: List[LogEntry]) -> str, create_export_package(self, logs: List[LogEntry], format: str) -> bytes

interface.name: MonitoringDashboard
interface.signature: class MonitoringDashboard: __init__(self, system_monitor: SystemMonitor), display_dashboard(self), update_metrics(self, metrics: Dict[str, Any]), handle_user_input(self)

tests.standards: 测试框架使用Python内置的unittest模块。监控系统准确性测试需要验证所有监控指标与系统实际状态对比。日志完整性测试验证日志收集、存储和检索准确性。性能影响测试确保监控不会降低系统性能（< 2%资源使用）。日志轮转测试测试日志清理和压缩机制。导出功能测试验证日志导出格式和隐私过滤。实时更新测试测试监控仪表盘响应性和准确性。搜索功能测试测试日志搜索和分析能力。

testIdea.description: 测试实时系统监控显示服务状态和性能指标的准确性
测试监控仪表盘的实时更新功能
测试结构化日志系统的日志级别和分类功能
测试日志格式在所有组件中的一致性
测试日志查看和分析工具的关键词搜索能力
测试日志分析工具的模式识别功能
测试日志轮转基于大小和时间的触发机制
测试日志压缩和归档系统的功能
测试日志导出功能支持多种格式（JSON、CSV、TXT）
测试日志导出时的隐私过滤功能
